name: cile-web-retrieval-module
title: CILE Web Retrieval Ontology Module
description: Normative extension for capability-aware, zero-spend web retrieval and browsing provenance.

WebRetrievalProvider.description: An external or platform service capable of web search, page reading, rendering, crawling or agentic research.

ProviderCapability.description: A bounded web capability such as SERP discovery, known-URL reading, rendered extraction or agentic research.

ProviderQuota.description: A dated description of a provider free allowance, reset policy and spending risk.

ProviderProjectBudget.description: A persistent project-side hard cap that bounds automatic provider use below a verified free allowance.

WebSearchInvocation.description: One bounded web-search invocation associated with a provider and candidate.

BrowserInvocation.description: One rendered-browser invocation against a candidate-bound public target.

AgenticResearchInvocation.description: One bounded multi-step or deep-research web invocation.

invariants: An automatic WebRetrievalProvider MUST have an implemented adapter and an explicit free-only runtime guard.
Queue browsing MUST NOT invoke WebSearchInvocation, BrowserInvocation or AgenticResearchInvocation.
A credit-priced provider MAY be automatic only when a persistent project budget is lower than a verified free allowance and a dedicated free-account guard is required at runtime.
Discovery providers SHOULD return bounded URLs to a lower-cost page-reading capability rather than request paid content extraction when a free reader is available.
Every invocation MUST return provider provenance, capability, free-quota unit, and project-budget metadata when applicable.
Failure or quota exhaustion MUST hand off to needs_web_search rather than trigger a paid fallback.
